API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPartner IntegrationsCreate Account Group
Create Account Group
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/accountGroups

Creates an AWS account group. You can create a maximum of 128 groups in each organization. To learn more, see Adding an Amazon Web Services Account Group.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
id
int32

The ID of the AWS account group.

name
string

The name of the AWS account group. Must be non-null, non-empty, unique, and 128 characters or fewer in length.

description
string

(Optional) The description of the AWS account group. Must be less than or equal to 512 characters.

cloudConnectorGroups
object[]
cloudType
string

The cloud type. The default and manadatory value is AWS.

Possible values: [AWS, AZURE, GCP]

publicCloudAccounts
object[]
Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
